newsitem.title: UK: John Lewis UK store sales up 13.6% in latest week.
newsitem.headline: John Lewis UK store sales up 13.6% in latest week.

text.p: The John Lewis Partnership said its UK weekly department store sales rose 13.6 percent in the week to July 26 from the same week a year earlier.
In the 26 weeks to July 26, sales were up 10.7 percent.
Total sales, including the Waitrose supermarket group, rose 9.6 percent in the latest week and 7.3 percent in the 26 week period.
A John Lewis spokesman said department store sales over the half-year as a whole were 10 percent ahead of last year.
